requirements.summary: Create a new "Ask Fred" chat page with a transcript UI, message input, and send actions (button + Enter) that persists for the current session.
acceptanceCriteria: A new top-level page exists in the app for asking questions (e.g., "Ask Fred") and is reachable from the site navigation on both desktop and mobile.
The page shows a chat transcript UI with clearly differentiated user vs. Fred messages.
Users can type a message and send it via a button and by pressing Enter (without losing multi-line capability if supported).
The chat persists for the current session at minimum (e.g., in React state); reloading the page may clear it unless explicit persistence is implemented.
All user-facing text on the page is in English and references the assistant name "Fred".

file_operations.description: Add the new user-facing "Ask Fred" page implementing a chat-style transcript (user vs. Fred styling), message composer (Textarea for multi-line), and send behavior (button + Enter to send, Shift+Enter for new line). Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card/Button/Textarea) to match existing styling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Render the new Fred chat page from the app's simple page-based routing so it can be navigated to as a top-level page.

requirements.summary: Generate Fred responses locally using deterministic FAQ/rules for Clash Royale fundamentals and provide safe fallbacks/refusals for unsupported or disallowed requests.
acceptanceCriteria: Fred responses are generated entirely client-side without calling any third-party AI/LLM APIs or external services.

Fred can answer a basic set of predefined Clash Royale questions (at least: elixir, win conditions, what a cycle deck is, what beatdown/control/siege/bridge spam are, and how to pick spells) with clear, helpful English responses.

For questions Fred cannot answer, Fred replies with an honest fallback (e.g., that it only knows a limited set of Clash Royale topics) and suggests relevant existing site sections (Beginner Guide / Deck Tips) and/or official links, without claiming to browse the web.

Fred does not provide instructions or methods to bypass restrictions, access controls, or “unblocked” gameplay; if prompted, Fred responds with a refusal aligned with the site’s existing legal notice.

file_operations.description: Implement a deterministic, client-only rules/FAQ responder for Fred: normalize user questions, match against predefined Clash Royale topics (elixir, win conditions, cycle decks, beatdown/control/siege/bridge spam, spell selection), and return helpful English answers. Include safety checks that refuse requests about bypassing restrictions or "unblocked" gameplay and provide an honest limited-knowledge fallback that points users to Beginner Guide / Deck Tips and official resources (without claiming web access).
Wire the chat UI to call the local fredKnowledgeBase responder for every send action, append Fred messages to the transcript, and ensure no network calls are made to generate responses.

requirements.summary: Extend the app’s page union/routing and SiteLayout navigation to include the new Fred page while preserving existing pages and admin-only navigation behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: The App page union/type is extended to include the new Fred page and the page renders correctly when selected.
SiteLayout navigation includes the new Fred page link for all users, and the Admin link still only appears for admins.
Navigation works correctly on desktop and mobile (mobile menu closes on navigation as it does for other pages).

file_operations.description: Extend the Page union/type to include the new Fred page and update the page switch to render FredChatPage when selected.
Add a new navigation item (e.g., "Ask Fred") visible to all users, while keeping the existing admin-only link behavior unchanged and preserving the current mobile-menu close-on-navigation behavior.

requirements.summary: Add an informative, on-page disclaimer on the Fred chat page clarifying offline/limited knowledge, informational-only guidance, no Supercell affiliation, and no bypass/unblocked help.
acceptanceCriteria: The Fred page includes a clearly visible disclaimer section in English.
The disclaimer aligns with the site’s existing stance (no hosting/embedding/bypass) and avoids implying the chat can access restricted content or provide circumvention instructions.
The disclaimer does not block normal chat usage (it is informative, not a modal that must be dismissed).

file_operations.description: Add a clearly visible, non-blocking disclaimer section on the page stating: Fred is an offline helper with limited knowledge; guidance is informational only; not affiliated with Supercell; and the site does not provide "unblocked" gameplay or bypass methods. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card/Alert styles if available) for consistent presentation; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add or reuse centralized disclaimer constants specific to the Fred page (offline helper, limited knowledge, informational-only, not affiliated) while keeping existing "no unblocked/bypass" stance consistent for reuse across the UI.
